messages:
nina_sales: FYI prospect (CareBridge) needs SOC2/ISO artifacts + wants to run a vendor pen test during the POC. They also asked for a secure place to upload scan reports. Can we just give them an SFTP endpoint?

paul_security: We prefer presigned S3 uploads for evidence (safer, auditable). SFTP is possible but slower to provision. Ask them whether tests will be intrusive; intrusive = Dedicated/Private only.

alex_se: For Dedicated sizing pls capture: model (e.g., mix of 13B/70B), peak rps, avg token length, concurrency, and whether they'll use batch vs streaming. Also staging CIDRs. Provisioning ~10-14 days.

rachel_finance: Pricing: 30d Dedicated trial = 40% monthly reserved + one-time setup. If they want short-lived single-test window we can pro-rate. I can draft a quick quote.

infra_bot: Automated: presigned S3 upload links supported. Default expiry 7 days. Request expiry and artifact list when asking. See https://redwood.internal/ops/evidence.

paul_security: Pen-test letter: vendor name, explicit scope (hosts/IPs), allowed techniques, time window, POC contact, signed rep. Also ask for insurance limit. We'll need 72h notice for intrusive tests.

nina_sales: I'll send a single checklist: intake link, SOC2/ISO upload, pen-test letter (or use our template), region/BYOK preference, Dedicated sizing fields, preferred test window, ask about presigned S3. Can someone paste the pen-test template?

paul_security: Use this minimal template: vendor, scope, techniques allowed, time window, contacts, signature. I'll attach our Pen-test Addendum if it's intrusive.

alex_se: I'll prepare the provisioning form and CIDR block fields.

rachel_finance: I'll attach a provisional quote and call out EU-data region costs if needed. Send to customer before EOD.
